items.name: claude-mem
items.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More

descriptions.zh: 每个代理的跨会话持久上下文 – 捕获代理在会话期间所做的所有操作，使用 AI 对其进行压缩，并将相关上下文注入到未来的会话中。适用于 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex、Gemini、Hermes、Copilot、OpenCode 等
descriptions.en: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More

items.name: Hyprland
items.description: Hyprland is an independent, highly customizable, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that doesn't sacrifice on its looks.

descriptions.zh: Hyprland 是一个独立的、高度可定制的、动态平铺 Wayland 合成器，并且不会牺牲其外观。

items.name: Claude-Code-Game-Studios
items.description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.

descriptions.zh: 将 Claude Code 转变为完整的游戏开发工作室 — 49 个 AI 代理、72 种工作流程技能以及反映真实工作室层次结构的完整协调系统。
descriptions.en: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.
